name: binskim
description: Microsoft PE binary security analyzer with SARIF compliance reporting

tools.description: PE/MSIL security analyzer with comprehensive vulnerability detection
tools.usage:
BinSkim analyze app.exe --output results.sarif # Analyze single binary to SARIF
BinSkim analyze *.dll --recurse --config custom.json # Recursive DLL analysis with config
BinSkim analyze --verbose --hashes C:\Program Files\MyApp\ # Detailed analysis with file hashes
BinSkim export-rules --output rules.xml # Export security rules
BinSkim dump binary.exe --pdb # Dump binary metadata with PDB info
